verification: Blender v012 layout guide was generated with world-space udder bounds (0.74 x 0.60 x 0.38 m), normalized hand contact 0.955, and a continuous front fence with side returns. This resolves guide geometry only; no final diffusion frame is certified.
limitations: The Blender guide provides spatial control only. It does not validate cartoon styling, actor identity, generated enclosure topology, H3 motion or visual acceptance.
root_cause: Text-only prompts cannot enforce spatial depth, occlusion boundaries, or physical enclosure topology in diffusion models. Prompt repetition fails.
fix_or_workaround: Use the deterministic 3D Blender guide defining five depth planes and measured contact points, then require pixel review of each generated frame. Scope closure to the guide geometry until a final frame passes that review.
prevention: Require 3D blocking guide whenever shots involve physical barriers, animal containment, or exact actor/prop contact.
